name: base-workstation
description: Cross-client tooling expected on Aren's primary development workstation.

install.note: Sentry's hosted remote MCP (streamable HTTP). --scope user is required: `claude mcp add` defaults to local/project scope, which would make the server visible only in the directory it was added from and hide it from the PUMPD checkout where the Sentry automations run. First use opens browser OAuth; re-auth in the browser when the session lapses. This is a client-local registration, independent of the claude.ai account connectors that disableClaudeAiConnectors turns off.
Sentry's hosted remote MCP. Browser OAuth per client on first use. On pumpd-workstation, Codex may instead receive Sentry via the sentry@openai-curated plugin; reconcile to avoid a duplicate server.

Expo's hosted remote MCP (streamable HTTP). --scope user is required; `claude mcp add` otherwise registers it only in the directory it was run from. OAuth-only with no PAT/CI fallback, so it works interactively but must never be relied on in cloud/cron runs. No Codex twin is asserted here: pumpd-workstation deliberately expects a raw Codex expo MCP to be absent (codex.duplicate-expo-mcp), because Codex receives expo from the openai-curated catalog.

Supabase's hosted remote MCP (streamable HTTP), authenticated by browser OAuth — the committed recipe carries no headers or tokens. --scope user is required for the same reason as the other hosted MCPs.

Vendor-owned skill from expo/skills (MIT) — installed, never mirrored into this repo. -g is required: `skills add` defaults to project scope. --skill takes one skill per flag; repeat the flag to batch.

Authenticate the Sentry hosted MCP (https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp/avad-technologies-llc/pumpd) in each client via browser OAuth, and re-auth when the session lapses. Local scheduled runs (e.g. pumpd-sentry-miner) reuse the local OAuth session, so keeping this authed locally is what keeps those automations working.

Authenticate the Expo hosted MCP (https://mcp.expo.dev/mcp) via browser OAuth in each client, and re-auth when the session lapses. OAuth-only: there is no PAT/header fallback, so this MCP works interactively but must not be depended on in cloud or cron runs.
Authenticate the Supabase hosted MCP (https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp) via browser OAuth, and re-auth when the session lapses.
